Definition: Jithran, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Ithran is named 3 times in the Bible, and the passages here are Genesis 36:26; 1 Chronicles 1:41; 1 Chronicles 7:37. In Genesis 36:26 we read, "And these are the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran." It appears again in 1 Chronicles 7:37: "Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera."
TheologicalSignificance: Ithran appears only briefly, yet I hold that God knew this life fully. His name stands in the record, and that is enough for me.
